{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Kurtzen]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] suffered from a '''genetic disorder''' as early as [[150 BBY/Legends|150 BBY]]. That year, they encountered [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists chartered by the [[Bakur Mining Corporation]]. The Humans' technology helped eradicate the genetic disease. Nevertheless, Kurtzen population levels remained low for decades.
